New York's Diamond District: the House just gave Washington power to raise India's tariff tenfold. The Russia sanctions bill passed 262-159 Wednesday; it lets the president tax India up to 100%.

India ships most of what 47th Street sells, at a 10% tariff today. Jewelers of America is fighting for an exemption: "It makes no sense to add tariffs on these products," JA's David Bonaparte said.

New York's trade, just over the Hudson: nine New Jersey jewelers have lost a case to a smash-and-grab robbery since January, the Jewelers' Security Alliance says, most recently September 2nd in Bogota.

Jersey City, Union, Perth Amboy, Newark, Orange, Edison, Wayne, Iselin and Bogota have each been hit. JSA has circulated a dozen tips: split high-value stock across cases, door buzzers, glass-break alarms, armed or uniformed guards during hours.
